integrity: All pairwise incidence tests are exact over \(\mathbb Q(a,b,i)\), with \(a^4=2\), \(b^4=3\), and \(i^2=-1\). The spectrum is certified by an exact annihilating polynomial and exact traces rather than floating-point eigenvalue calculations.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the explicit special member X_{-1/8}. Completeness of the 85-line list is taken from Yu--Zhu; the package independently verifies all incidence and spectral consequences of that list. Literature search cannot exclude an unpublished prior computation.
title: Integral spectrum of the 85-line incidence graph on the Yu--Zhu quintic
